market.summary: Wall Street ended Friday sharply lower on a tech sell-off, but GIFT Nifty points to a firm open, about 1% above Friday's Nifty close, and crude has eased about 2% from its highs. FIIs were large net buyers on Friday while DIIs sold. The open looks positive for large caps; Friday's small-cap selling is the thing to watch for these holdings.

points.text: GIFT Nifty about 23,299 at 7:00 IST, up roughly 246 points (+1.1%) on Nifty's Friday close of 23,053.
US Friday close: Nasdaq -2.86% (25,437), S&P 500 -1.82% (7,580), Dow -1.09%; Intel fell about 29%. VIX ended at 19.4.
Asia last session: Hang Seng +1.46%, Shanghai -1.44%, Nikkei roughly flat.
Brent about $111 this morning (-2.1%), WTI about $103, as markets watch Qatar-mediated US-Iran talks; rupee near 94.94 per dollar.
FII/DII provisional cash on 30 Oct: FIIs net bought Rs 3,598.54 Cr, DIIs net sold Rs 817.51 Cr.
Friday India: Nifty +0.51% to 23,053.10, but Smallcap 100 -1.85% and Midcap 100 -0.93%; consumer durables and media the weakest sectors.

market.watch: Whether small and mid caps join the gap-up; Nifty resistance 23,175-23,285 per Business Standard's analyst, support 23,000.
